pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.text: Start free and upgrade when you need more. Pay monthly, or yearly and save. Cancel at any time.

confirm.title: Confirm your subscription
confirm.text: Press the button to confirm your email address for the EU Jobs newsletter.
confirm.doneText: Thanks for confirming. Career tips, hiring trends and platform news will reach your inbox.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from the newsletter
unsubscribe.text: Press the button to stop receiving the EU Jobs newsletter.
unsubscribe.doneText: You will not receive the newsletter any more. You can subscribe again at any time.

admin.title: Website
admin.description: The public website’s blog, newsletter and subscribers.

blog.caption: Blog posts

newsletter.emptyText: An issue collects the newest jobs and blog posts and goes to every confirmed subscriber.
newsletter.subject: Subject
newsletter.caption: Newsletter issues
newsletter.deleteText: The draft is removed for good. Nothing was sent.
newsletter.issueDescription: Pick the jobs and posts, write a short intro, check the preview and send.
newsletter.fallbackHint: Leave empty to send the English subject to subscribers in this language.
newsletter.introHint: A few sentences before the jobs. Leave a blank line between paragraphs. Empty uses the English intro.
newsletter.noJobs: No open jobs to feature right now.

newsletter.sendingNote: Emails go out in batches of 100 a minute. You can leave this page.

newsletter.confirmNewText: It goes only to the {{count}} people who confirmed after this issue was sent. Everyone else is not mailed again.

errors.recipients: Nobody has confirmed the newsletter yet.

editor.description: Write in one language; visitors see posts in their language, or English ones when there are none.
editor.title: Title
editor.excerptHint: One or two sentences shown under the title.
editor.coverRequired: A cover image is needed to publish.

post.ctaTitle: Find a role that fits you
post.ctaText: Build your profile once, get AI-matched jobs from trusted employers across the EU and the UK, and apply in a few clicks.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.text: Browse every open role on EU Jobs without an account. Sign in only when you are ready to apply.
jobs.emptyText: Try other keywords, another place or a different category. New roles appear here as soon as companies publish them.
jobs.signInNote: Sign in to apply or save. You will come straight back to this job.
jobs.signUp: New here? Create a free account

agencies.titleAccent: keep your talent on the books
agencies.lead: Post short-term and contract jobs for the companies you work with, take candidates onto your books with your own agreement, and let EU Jobs check that each placement keeps to its contract.

steps.title: Add your clients and post jobs
steps.text: Each job is for one client, with its dates, pay rate and hours. Show the client’s name or keep it confidential.

steps.title: Take candidates onto your books
steps.text: Candidates ask to join or you invite them. They read your agreement and agree to it in the app.

steps.title: Place them, and place them again
steps.text: Hire for a job and the placement starts. When it ends you can offer the same person their next job.

clients.title: Clients
clients.text: Every company you recruit for in one list, linked to its EU Jobs page when it has one.

books.title: Talent on your books
books.text: Requests, invitations and who agreed to which version of your agreement.

contracts.title: Contracts read by AI
contracts.text: On Agency Plus, AI reads your agreement and each job’s contract and quotes the clause behind every rule. You check and confirm.

placements.title: Placements that keep to their rules
placements.text: Exclusivity, notice, cooling-off and weekly hours are checked before anyone takes another job.

hiring.title: Every hiring tool
hiring.text: The pipeline, candidate search, messages and interviews that recruiters use.
